speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Disseminated Gonococcal Infection. The clinical triad of migratory polyarthralgia (knee), septic arthritis (wrist), and fever in a sexually active young male is classic for gonococcal arthritis, which can mimic Lyme disease. The skin lesions are likely sterile pustules or petechiae, not the expanding erythema migrans of Lyme.
